name: com.feedmcp/mcp
title: FeedMCP — Social Media Data MCP
description: Social media data MCP across 21 global & Chinese platforms (193 endpoints). Pay per call.

tools.name: find
tools.description: 按自然语言找合适的数据接口，返回接口 ID、说明和每次价格。免费。Find endpoints for what the user wants, with their IDs and prices. Free.

query.description: 用户想要的数据，例如「TikTok 视频评论」「小红书笔记评论」「X 趋势」/ What the user wants, e.g. "tiktok comments", "youtube channel subscribers"

platform.description: 只在这个平台里找（可选）/ Limit to one platform

tools.name: describe
tools.description: 看一个接口的参数、返回对象和价格。免费。Parameters, returned object and price of one endpoint. Free.

tools.name: call
tools.description: 调用一个接口取数据，成功才扣费，返回里写明扣了多少。Call an endpoint; charged only on success, and the answer says what it cost.

params.description: 接口参数，见 describe。翻页时传 cursor / Parameters, see describe; pass cursor for the next page

max_price.description: 这次最多愿意付多少美元，超过就不调用，例如 "0.01" / Refuse the call if it costs more than this (USD)

idempotency_key.description: 重试同一次调用时传同一个值，不会重复扣费 / Same value on a retry is never charged twice

tools.name: account
tools.description: 查余额，以及当前这把 Key 已经花了多少。Balance, and what this key has spent.
